project_title: Dilwale Job Le Jayenge - Bollywood Recruitment RPG

entry_surfaces./: Retro Bollywood RPG Title Screen with neon gold-magenta marquee, 16-bit CSS stage, opening cinematic sequence, journey selection portal, HUD status bar, and resume power vault drawer

character_svg_guidelines.format: Hand-crafted inline SVG sprites with 16-bit retro pixel and isometric charm, rich color shading, expressive Bollywood posture, and CSS micro-animations

shivam.archetype: Passionate Hero / Growth Hacker with Bollywood swagger
visual_traits: Dynamic wind-blown stylish hero hair (dark chocolate/black with purple sheen)
Leather jacket with rolled sleeves over clean white tee / Wispr badge
Holding a glowing holographic growth strategy card / tablet in hand
Pose: Confident action hero stance, left arm outstretched towards dream, smirk

papa.archetype: Skeptical, dramatic Indian Father / Senior HR Recruiter
visual_traits: Distinguished grey-streaked mustache and stern eyebrows
Formal traditional Nehru jacket / bandhgala in royal crimson-magenta
Thick reading glasses perched on nose, holding a stack of 2000 rejected paper resumes that swirl around him
Pose: Dramatic Amrish Puri / Bollywood patriarch index finger pointed, skeptical frown yet secretly intrigued

miss_growth.archetype: The Dream Role Personified (Growth Lead at Wispr Flow)
visual_traits: Golden glowing aura / starlight particles around her silhouette
Elegant modern Bollywood attire with flowing dupatta made of neon metric charts and growth vectors
Holding a glowing crystal orb displaying hockey-stick MRR curve and 10x multiplier
Pose: Graceful, aspirational Bollywood heroine turn, inviting the worthy candidate to step forward

opening_cinematic_spec.timing: 18 to 22 seconds total (auto-advancing with typewriter effect, or manual Next click / spacebar, or instant 'Skip Intro' button)

beats.speaker: Recruiter Papa
beats.hindi_dialogue: Ek dream job. Do hazaar applications. Aur ek recruiter… jo resumes dekh dekh kar thak chuka tha!
beats.english_sub: One dream job. 2,000 applications. And one recruiter... exhausted by generic PDFs!
beats.visual_state: Papa standing amid flying swirling white sheets with red rejection stamps; dark thunderous purple backdrop.

beats.speaker: Shivam (The Hero)
beats.hindi_dialogue: Par ek ladka tha… jise PDF bhejna manzoor nahi tha!
beats.english_sub: But there was one challenger... who refused to be just another resume in the pile!
beats.visual_state: Shivam leaps into the spotlight with glowing strategy cards, cutting through flying CVs; golden spotlight.

beats.speaker: Recruiter Papa
beats.hindi_dialogue: THEHRO! Meri beti ke liye hazaaron rishte aaye hain. Tum mein aisa kya khaas hai?
beats.english_sub: STOP! Thousands have sought this coveted role. What makes YOU worthy of Miss Growth?
beats.visual_state: Papa points dramatically with lightning strike effect; split screen stare-down (Papa vs Shivam).

beats.speaker: Shivam
beats.hindi_dialogue: Uncle ji, resume nahi… live demo aur growth engine lekar aaya hoon!
beats.english_sub: Sir, I didn't bring a resume... I brought proof of execution and real growth tactics!
beats.visual_state: Miss Growth shines in the background; Shivam readies his deck; freeze frame transition into Journey Choice.

animations.typewriter: Staggered letter rendering at 25ms per character with skip-on-click
animations.card_hover: scale: 1.03, y: -6px, glow shadow with 0.25s ease-out
animations.bollywood_strobe: Dramatic flash overlay on Papa's 'THEHRO!' interruption
animations.flying_resumes: CSS particle animation with floating PDFs and golden sparkles

accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full arrow key navigation and Enter / Space selection on journey cards, dialogue advance with Spacebar or Enter, Escape to close drawers
accessibility.contrast_guarantee: All text strictly exceeds APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio using deep purple/obsidian backgrounds with bright gold, white, and neon text
accessibility.reduced_motion: All motion transitions wrapped with prefers-reduced-motion checks disabling high velocity transforms
accessibility.test_ids: All buttons, journey cards, modal triggers, dialogue boxes, and navigation tabs have unique data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace default fonts in /app/frontend/src/index.css with @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk for headings and @fontsource-variable/outfit for body text, @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono for stats.
2. Render the app with high Bollywood flair: bold typography, retro 16-bit RPG gold borders, pixel badges, glowing dialogue boxes, and interactive audio feedback (synthesized Web Audio tones).

3. Implement the 3 inline SVG character sprites (Shivam, Recruiter Papa, Miss Growth) using the provided color palettes and expressive poses — do NOT use generic stock photos or unbranded placeholders.
4. Build the 4-beat opening cinematic with typewriter effect, auto-progress timer, 'Next Beat', 'Replay', and 'Skip Intro' buttons.
5. Build the Journey Selection screen featuring the two primary cards: 'Father's Journey' and 'Shivam's Journey', linking to active gameplay placeholders and the 3 locked arena teasers.
6. Build the top HUD with 3 Heart indicators, Sound Toggle, Learning Journal popup, and the 21-card Resume Power Vault drawer with category filter pills.
7. Add test-id attributes to all interactive elements for robust test coverage.
